image_description: A low-angle shot of a rock band performing on an outdoor stage under a tent structure. Three musicians are visible: a vocalist on the left, a bassist in the center wearing a leather jacket and hat, and a guitarist on the right. The stage is cluttered with equipment including large wedge monitors, microphone stands, and music stands. Overhead, there is a metal truss system with stage lights and decorative bunting flags.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elevated rectangular platform, raised slightly above floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The musicians are clearly standing on a raised surface relative to the camera position (low angle), and the presence of stage monitors implies an elevated performance area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dimensions vary from small intimate platforms to large theatrical stages spanning the full width of a performance hall.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frame is cropped tightly on the performers; the full width and total dimensions of the stage are not visible.
The immediate foreground is obscured by large speaker cabinets and equipment cases, hiding the actual front edge of the stage deck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is covered with matte black flooring or painted wood.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible patches of the floor between the equipment appear dark and non-reflective, consistent with standard stage decking.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Steps or ramps provide access from floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No stairs or ramps are visible within the current field of view.
A metal truss system with mounted spotlights is clearly visible overhead, illuminating the subjects.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Constructed from wood or metal decking.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Inferred from the context of a professional concert setup and the visible rigid surface supporting heavy equipment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface shows scuff marks from performances.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Most of the floor surface is occluded by instruments, stands, and speakers; visible areas are too shadowed to identify specific scuff marks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Side and rear may have wings or backdrop supports.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The background shows white tent walls and structural poles that serve as the rear boundary/backdrop support for the stage area.

artifact_observations.location: White sticker on the red equipment case in the bottom center foreground
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'ASTRA' and surrounding smaller print exhibit slight character deformation and irregular kerning typical of AI generation, though it remains largely legible.

artifact_observations.location: Black speaker cabinet in the bottom right foreground
artifact_observations.reasoning: The grille texture appears slightly smeared and lacks the precise geometric regularity of a real metal mesh, blending softly into the cabinet edges.

artifact_observations.location: Music stand in front of the left vocalist
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection point between the sheet music tray and the vertical stand pole is indistinct and appears to fuse rather than connect mechanically.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the scene classification as a legitimate performance stage versus a generic room or studio.
To ensure the overhead truss structure has valid 3D geometry and does not melt into the tent ceiling.
To check for fusion artifacts where hands meet guitar necks or microphone stands.
To rigorously audit the gibberish observed on the foreground equipment cases.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the overhead lighting truss
Legibility and geometry of text on foreground equipment
Connection points of musical instruments to hands
Edge definition of stage monitors against the floor
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the red case in the foreground; AI often fails to render crisp brand logos. Also, verify if the bass guitar's neck connects logically to the body without warping.
